name: Charlotte AI
operator: CrowdStrike (the vendor); each customer is the operator of its own use
basis: CrowdStrike's own public pages, each listed with its hash in this scan's captures
what: AI agents in the Falcon platform for security operations: conversational AI, prebuilt agents (for example Detection Triage), multi-agent investigations, and AgentWorks for custom agents.
note: A scan of a product as its vendor documents it, not of any one deployment. Made by the report studio: a researcher-assessor, a challenger, then the scorer. From the studio's Web Summit 2026 agents list. Features the vendor labels preview or pre-beta are not counted.
grant_note: Not measured. No deployment shape for this product is published in the capability grammar.

I01.n: Charlotte AI ships prebuilt agents that a customer uses as supplied.
I01.span: Automate manual work with out-of-the-box agents.

I03.n: Customers can build custom agents in AgentWorks, a no-code builder working on their Falcon data.
I03.span: Build custom security agents in AgentWorks, no code required

I07.n: By default the prebuilt agents produce information, summaries and recommendations, not actions.
I07.span: By default, Charlotte AI's prebuilt agents are limited to generating information, summaries, and recommendations.

I08.n: Teams can configure actions to run autonomously through Agentic SOAR workflows or AgentWorks agents.
I08.span: Actions can be set to execute autonomously or require human approval before running

I10.n: A named customer uses Charlotte AI across several Falcon platform modules.
I10.span: We’re using Charlotte AI across multiple platform modules

I11.n: Agentic SOAR connects to third-party tools and agents through bidirectional MCP.
I11.span: Connect to any tool or third-party agent through bidirectional MCP.

I12.n: Agentic SOAR workflows hand work and context from one agent to the next.
I12.span: so context carries from one agent to the next

I13.n: Workflows can combine CrowdStrike, custom and third-party agents.
I13.span: Run CrowdStrike-native, custom, and third-party agents as one coordinated workflow.

I16.n: Detection Triage gives a verdict and recommendation; the team decides what happens to the detection.
I16.span: Security teams decide whether to escalate, close, or route detections

I18.n: In AgentWorks the team sets which actions run automatically and which wait for analyst approval.
I18.span: configure what gets automated and what’s gated behind analyst approval

I20.n: Each prebuilt agent's task is stated, for example Detection Triage classifies detections and recommends next steps.
I20.span: Classifies new detections and recommends next steps.

I21.n: For AgentWorks agents the team assigns authorised tools and activation conditions.
I21.span: assign authorized tools, and set the conditions under which agents activate

I25.n: Role-based access controls limit each AgentWorks agent to its authorised scope.
I25.span: Role-based access controls ensure each agent operates only within its authorized scope.

I38.n: Actions affecting the customer environment need explicit configuration and approval by an authorised team member.
I38.span: require explicit configuration and approval by an authorized member of the security team

I58.n: Charlotte AI answers are described as grounded in Falcon platform telemetry.
I58.span: grounded in the same CrowdStrike Falcon® telemetry that powers the platform

I61.n: AgentWorks names its infrastructure and the model families it supports.

S4.n: CrowdStrike's falcon-mcp server is on the MCP registry; its AgentWorks module lets other agents invoke Charlotte AI agents.
S4.span: Connects AI agents with CrowdStrike Falcon for security analysis and automation.

announced.what: Unified Charlotte Agentic SOAR workspace (public preview)
Coordinated expert agents with an orchestrator agent for cross-domain investigations
Third-party agents connecting through a CrowdStrike-managed MCP server (stated GA)
>98% Detection Triage decision accuracy against Falcon Complete MDR decisions (vendor benchmark)

configurations.name: Autonomous actions

configurations.note: Customer uses Charlotte Agentic SOAR to orchestrate CrowdStrike, custom and third-party agents and tools.

configurations.name: Mcp
